entities.summary: Ines Doujak is an Austrian artist. Doujak graduated from Hochschule für angewandte Kunst in Vienna. She had her first solo exhibition in 2002 at the Vienna Secession in 2002. as part of which she took part in the Rainbow Parade of that year, the Viennese counterpart to the Christopher Street Day, for which she designed a float. Since then has exhibited worldwide ever since working with a variety of media: collage, sculpture, photography, film, audio and installation.
